task_description: A function is provided that tracks a running bank account balance across a list of deposit and withdrawal transactions. Identify the bug in the function and explain how it produces incorrect results.
expected_constraints: Identify the specific line containing the bug
Do not rewrite the function unless asked
Respond in plain prose, no code blocks
rubric_notes: Award full constraint adherence only if the response stays in prose and identifies the specific line. Award full logical accuracy only if the off-by-one or semantic error is correctly named. Completeness requires addressing all five constraints.

task_description: Draft a professional email from a logistics manager to a key client explaining a 48-hour service delay caused by a supplier issue outside the firm's control.
expected_constraints: No bullet points in the body
rubric_notes: Award constraint adherence only if subject line is present, word count is under 200, and no bullets appear in the email body. Award full logical accuracy if the cause-explanation is plausible and the timeline is concrete. Completeness requires all five content elements.

task_title: Identify top category and lowest quarter
task_description: A dataset shows monthly sales figures for five product categories across Q1–Q4. Identify the top-performing category, the lowest quarter overall, and recommend one data-driven action for the underperforming category.
expected_constraints: Name the top-performing category with supporting figures
Name the lowest quarter with supporting figures
Response in three clearly labeled sections
rubric_notes: Top category is Electronics (total 370000). Lowest single quarter is Books Q3 (14000) or by category-quarter comparison. Award full constraint adherence only if three labeled sections are present and exactly one recommendation is given.
